skills.name: Might

skills.name: Brawn

skills.name: Vitality

skills.name: Fortitude

skills.name: Hardiness

skills.name: Insight

skills.name: Survival

skills.name: Resourcefulness

skills.name: Deception

skills.name: Intimidation
